answer_2.quote: We calculate the overall recall R by averaging the maximum values of all rows and the overall precision P by averaging the one-to-one precisions ... finally, the overall F1 is computed with R and P. ... The ROBUST Metric ... we first calculate the P/R/F1 scores of the model on each sentence, and then select the scores from the sentence with the worst F1 as the ultimate robustness scores.

answer_4.quote: All annotators undergo training with tutorials to pass a final examination, and our batch-wise sampling validation ensure an annotation accuracy of over 90%... We perform a thorough paraphrase annotation with three types of corrections: Grammar Correcting, Phrase Replacing, Sentence Rewriting... In the second stage, we leverage human experts to annotate N-ary knowledge tuples on the paraphrases... The guideline involves recognizing the predicate, finding the arguments, optionally obtaining time and location arguments.
answer_4.guideline: Human annotators correct generated paraphrases (grammar, phrase replacement, sentence rewriting) and then annotate N‑ary knowledge tuples following a step‑wise guideline: identify the predicate, find arguments, and optionally add time/location attributes, ensuring completeness, assertedness, informativeness, and atomicity.
